_what: Session J Part 2 — same-session hard negatives, fit split only.

leakage_controls.rule: no training pair may come from a session present in ANY held-out haystack
leakage_controls._note: negatives are drawn only from the gold turn's own session, and gold-session collision with held-out haystacks is nearly zero — hence a single exclusion rather than a large one. Measured, not assumed.

split_by_conversation_not_query._why_it_matters: with shared gold sessions present, a query-id split would put the same conversation on both sides of the train/val boundary
